name: Single-Leg Balance on Foam Pad with Eyes Closed
setup: Stand on one leg on a folded mat or foam pad, a wall within reach.
cues: Close your eyes and keep the floor under heel, big toe and little toe.
Heel, big toe, little toe: press all three into the floor.
Stand tall and still, like a post planted in the floor.

faults.fault: Foot rolling out onto the little toe
faults.fix: Press the big-toe joint back down into the floor.

faults.fault: Hip dropping on the free side
faults.fix: Keep your belt line level, like a tray of drinks on it.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise on Flat Floor with Eyes Closed
setup: Stand barefoot on a flat floor, a wall within reach.
cues: Close your eyes and keep the floor under heel, big toe and little toe.
Rise on one foot through the big-toe joint and lower slow to the floor.
Heel, big toe, little toe: press all three into the floor.

faults.fix: Keep the toes long and soft on the floor; the arch does the lifting.

faults.fault: Rolling to the outside of the foot
faults.fix: Press the big-toe joint back down into the floor.

name: Single-Leg Balance on Toes with Eyes Closed
setup: Stand barefoot on a flat floor, a wall within reach.
cues: Close your eyes and keep the floor under heel, big toe and little toe.
Rise onto the ball of one foot and hold still and tall for the count.
Heel, big toe, little toe: press all three into the floor.

faults.fix: Keep the toes long and soft on the floor; the arch does the lifting.

faults.fault: Rolling to the outside of the foot
faults.fix: Press the big-toe joint back down into the floor.
